title: Morphisms to the section-ring Proj with the fraction formula
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and L an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let S be its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Assume that for every x in X there is a homogeneous s of positive degree d with x in the nonvanishing locus of s [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. There exists f:X -> Proj(S) [def-pc-proj] such that for every positive-degree homogeneous s, n >= 0 and homogeneous xi of degree nd, the pullback of xi/s^n on f^{-1}(D_+(s)), multiplied by the restricted tensor-power section s^n, is the restricted section xi. No assertion about the inverse-image locus is included.

source.place: Constructions Lemma 01N8 (lemma-converse-construction), local quotient construction, overlap and inverse-image calculation; Properties Lemma 01PZ (lemma-map-into-proj), proof and clause (1)

proof.text: For each positive-degree homogeneous section s of degree d, the nonvanishing open X_s is open and s trivializes L^{tensor d} there by [lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes]. On X_s define a ring homomorphism rho_s:S_(s)\toGamma(X_s,O_X) by rho_s(xi/s^n)=s^{-n}xi, where xi is homogeneous of degree nd; the relation defining graded localization is respected because multiplication by the unit s on X_s is invertible. By [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] and the affine description D_+(s)=Spec(S_(s)) in [def-pc-proj], rho_s determines a morphism f_s:X_s\toD_+(s).

source.place: Properties Lemma 01PZ proof; Constructions Lemma 01N8, construction of psi_(f) on S_(f)

proof.text: Let s and t have positive degrees d and e. On X_s the degree-zero chart function t^d/s^e maps under rho_s to the quotient of the two sections of L^{tensor de}; by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme] and [def-pc-proj], the inverse image of D_+(t) inside D_+(s) is the locus where this quotient is invertible. Since s trivializes L^{tensor d}, this is X_s cap X_t: in each residue field t(x)^d is nonzero exactly when t(x) is nonzero. Thus f_s and f_t both map X_s cap X_t to D_+(st). On that overlap define rho_st:S_(st)\toGamma(X_s cap X_t,O_X) by xi/(st)^n |\to xi/(st)^n, dividing sections of L^{tensor n(d+e)} by the trivializing section (st)^n. The localization map S_(s)\toS_(st) sends a/s^k to a t^k/(st)^k, whose image under rho_st is a t^k/(s^k t^k)=a/s^k=rho_s(a/s^k)|_{X_s cap X_t}; similarly S_(t)\toS_(st) sends b/t^k to b s^k/(st)^k, and rho_st gives rho_t(b/t^k) on the overlap. Thus both restrictions have the same ring map from S_(st), and their morphisms to the affine chart D_+(st)=Spec(S_(st)) agree by [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-into-affine-scheme].

source.place: Properties Lemma 01PZ proof and Constructions Lemma 01N8, overlap calculation

proof.text: The opens X_s cover X by hypothesis, and the maps f_s agree on pairwise overlaps by Step 2. Therefore [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing] gives a unique canonical morphism f:X\toProj(S) restricting to f_s on every X_s.

source.place: Properties Lemma 01PZ proof, gluing the local maps constructed from Lemma 01N8

proof.text: On each nonvanishing chart the glued morphism restricts to the quotient morphism. The equation for the pullback of xi/s^n follows there by the definition of its ring map. For any other chart pullback, restrict to the covering intersections and use the overlap quotient identities in step 2. Sheaf separatedness gives equality of the two tensor-power sections on the entire inverse-image open. The n=0 case is the coefficient map for the tensor unit; the empty open is covered vacuously.

mathlib_searches.query: A scheme covered by nonvanishing loci of sections of an invertible module admits a morphism to Proj of its graded section ring pulling back homogeneous fractions as quotients of tensor power sections

The fraction pullback identity for a morphism into Proj implies that a point is in the inverse image of a homogeneous basic open exactly when the corresponding invertible module section does not vanish
